scope: Partition existing primary links before target curation; structural evidence and raw TRAIN reach, not semantic acceptance.
closed_class_basis: Pronouns/determiners/articles/interrogatives/prepositions/conjunctions/auxiliary-or-modal forms cannot be admitted as rare content homographs. Ambiguous have/do/etc require a separately qualified source-usage rule; this baseline does not imply their content uses never qualify.
source_head_policy: Modern lexical meanings only, complete source surface, lowercase ordinary headwords rather than uppercase initials/acronym/name heads. Inflected forms separated unless source is the exact canonical head or an explicit alternative spelling; no guessed stems.
source_sense_policy: Active native glosses exclude marked historical/rare/form-of/alt-of entries only. Every active lexical entry and POS must be represented. Exact normalized native-gloss↔English-group label matches prove covered glosses; a genuinely single-definition entry with its scoped translation groups is a separate one-definition evidence stratum. Other source sense coverage remains unresolved, never silently complete.
target_consensus: Intersect attested valid target face+reading sets over EVERY explicit English source translation group for every active source entry/POS. Missing groups yield missing evidence, not agreement. Direct native-gloss supplements remain separate supporting evidence and cannot erase missing English sense groups. At least one surviving target can serve all groups; multiple equivalent targets do not invalidate consensus.
target_surface_policy: Use only existing complete attested target heads, matching POS, nonempty mandatory reading, non-contradicted/unqualified linked terms. Exact normalized unchanged source/target faces excluded from useful count. Bound stems, absent readings and uncertain inflected target realization remain separate.
selection: Content-only, source-disjoint complete words, one occurrence per canonical source family, TRAIN-frequency order. Densities10/25/50%, max(1,floor(words*density)). Protected URLs/email/code, capitals and identifiers use existing research guard.
knowledge_policy: Global source family order by summed TRAIN occurrences; actual selected family IDs retained, same order across languages. A family comprises explicit common lowercased head and source POS set; no suffix stripping or collapsing unrelated senses. Report group count and unknown family cases.
outputs: actual TRAIN eligible occurrence and message reach, message-mean and token-weighted content depth
source/target evidence gaps and representative examples
limits: Any admitted research face still needs actual mixed-output semantic review.
TRAIN persona role-play frequency is not global chat prevalence.
Native boundary/readings/pronunciation/runtime cost unqualified for new inventory.
No prior-selected-in-test eligibility gate; no new heldout sample; no app activation.
